name: onto
description: MCP-native ontology review runtime with context-isolated lenses and controlled deliberation. Installs a one-click Claude Desktop server that reviews and reconstructs ontologies; collects provider config on first run and seeds ~/.onto/settings.json.

provider.title: LLM provider
provider.description: The LLM provider that runs ontology review and reconstruction (for example: anthropic, openai). Determines which model family and auth routes are available.

model.title: Model
model.description: The provider model id used for review and reconstruction (for example: claude-opus-4, gpt-5). Must be a model the chosen provider supports.

auth.title: Auth route (optional)
auth.description: How the provider is authenticated. Choices: api_key | oauth | local. Leave blank to use the default OAuth route — for provider=openai this is the OAuth subscription (Codex) route, which IGNORES the pasted API key. Pick api_key to authenticate with the key you paste below.

api_key.title: API key (optional)
api_key.description: Provider API key, used only when auth=api_key. Stored in the host keychain and passed to the server via env; the onto runtime persists only the env-var NAME, never the key value. Leave blank when using the OAuth or local route.
